response.rationale: TreatmentProduct is a catalog item (the product). Treatment is the event of applying a product. They live in separate repositories: TreatmentProductRepository (node 4799b1081a692790) holds `Map<string, TreatmentProduct>`, while ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c) gets treatments from `this.treatments.findAll()`, which the graph maps to TreatmentRepository.findAll. ReportService also looks up products one at a time with TreatmentProductRepository.findById, which suggests each treatment points to a product. TreatmentService keeps registerProduct/listProducts separate from recordTreatment. They are related concepts, not the same one.
